description: Stations de maintenance pour vélos is a dataset listed in Boulogne-Billancourt open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Seine Ouest. Localisation des stations de maintenance (gonflage, réparation, lavage) pour vélos sur le Territoire de la Ville de Boulogne-Billancourt Retrouvez la carte interactive "Circuler à vélo" sur SoCarto. Coverage: Boulogne-Billancourt. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements, Mobilité, Vélo. Its keywords are Plan climat, Vélos. The portal shows 12 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-boulognebillancourt-seineouest-portal.
